in_hebrew.name: ביקה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Becka' is derived from the Hebrew word 'bekah', which means 'joy' or 'happiness'. It is a feminine name and is used in the Bible to refer to a female donkey.

in_greek.name: Βεκκα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Becka' is derived from the Greek word 'bekos', which means 'rejoicing' or 'blessed'. It is a rare name in the Bible, and there is no direct reference to it.

in_latin.name: Becka
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Becka' is the same as the English name and has the same meaning. There is no direct biblical reference to this name in Latin.
